chunks.text: Figure 1: A quiet corner of a home workshop, with daylight and a bench of hand tools
chunks.spokenText: Figure 1: A quiet corner of a home workshop, with daylight and a bench of hand tools

chunks.text: A workshop does not need a room.
chunks.spokenText: A workshop does not need a room.

chunks.text: It needs a place where you can leave a project half finished without losing it, and where the tools you use most are within reach.
chunks.spokenText: It needs a place where you can leave a project half finished without losing it, and where the tools you use most are within reach.

chunks.text: Most people who begin woodworking at home start with a kitchen table and a borrowed clamp, and that is a fine way to start.
chunks.spokenText: Most people who begin woodworking at home start with a kitchen table and a borrowed clamp, and that is a fine way to start.

chunks.text: This chapter is about making the small, sensible choices that will make every later project easier.
chunks.spokenText: This chapter is about making the small, sensible choices that will make every later project easier.

chunks.text: Choosing a Corner
chunks.spokenText: Choosing a Corner.

chunks.text: Look for a corner that gets steady light for most of the day.
chunks.spokenText: Look for a corner that gets steady light for most of the day.

chunks.text: Natural light is pleasant, but what matters more is that you can see the line you are cutting or sanding without moving your head into an awkward angle.
chunks.spokenText: Natural light is pleasant, but what matters more is that you can see the line you are cutting or sanding without moving your head into an awkward angle.

chunks.text: A sturdy bench at a comfortable height will do more for your accuracy than any single tool.
chunks.spokenText: A sturdy bench at a comfortable height will do more for your accuracy than any single tool.

chunks.text: If you stand to work, the bench top should sit a little below your elbow.
chunks.spokenText: If you stand to work, the bench top should sit a little below your elbow.

chunks.text: If you sit, it should be lower.
chunks.spokenText: If you sit, it should be lower.

chunks.text: The corner should also let you keep dust and offcuts in one place.
chunks.spokenText: The corner should also let you keep dust and offcuts in one place.

chunks.text: A fold-down bench or a simple plywood top on two trestles is enough.
chunks.spokenText: A fold-down bench or a simple plywood top on two trestles is enough.

chunks.text: Put a sheet of cheap hardboard or a moving blanket on the floor under it, so that spilled glue and sawdust are easy to sweep up.
chunks.spokenText: Put a sheet of cheap hardboard or a moving blanket on the floor under it, so that spilled glue and sawdust are easy to sweep up.

chunks.text: Plan for power as well as light.
chunks.spokenText: Plan for power as well as light.

chunks.text: Two or three sockets within a few steps of the bench will save you from running a long cable across the floor, which is both untidy and a tripping hazard.
chunks.spokenText: Two or three sockets within a few steps of the bench will save you from running a long cable across the floor, which is both untidy and a tripping hazard.

chunks.text: If you use a lamp, place it so that its light falls across the work from the side
chunks.spokenText: If you use a lamp, place it so that its light falls across the work from the side

chunks.text: opposite your dominant hand, which keeps your shadow off the cut.

chunks.text: A Starter Kit
chunks.spokenText: A Starter Kit.

chunks.text: You do not need everything at once.
chunks.spokenText: You do not need everything at once.

chunks.text: A useful starter kit fits in a single drawer and covers the work in the first four chapters of this book.
chunks.spokenText: A useful starter kit fits in a single drawer and covers the work in the first four chapters of this book.

chunks.text: A tape measure, preferably a steel rule as well
chunks.spokenText: A tape measure, preferably a steel rule as well.

chunks.text: A combination square, set to true at the factory and checked by you
chunks.spokenText: A combination square, set to true at the factory and checked by you.

chunks.text: A pencil that stays sharp and a marking knife for precise lines
chunks.spokenText: A pencil that stays sharp and a marking knife for precise lines.

chunks.text: A hand saw with fine teeth for crosscuts, and a shorter saw for detail work
chunks.spokenText: A hand saw with fine teeth for crosscuts, and a shorter saw for detail work.

chunks.text: Two or three bar clamps, or a set of F-clamps of mixed sizes
chunks.spokenText: Two or three bar clamps, or a set of F-clamps of mixed sizes.

chunks.text: A block plane for trimming edges
chunks.spokenText: A block plane for trimming edges.

chunks.text: Sandpaper in a few grits, a sanding block, and a dust mask
chunks.spokenText: Sandpaper in a few grits, a sanding block, and a dust mask.

chunks.text: Safety glasses, hearing protection for power tools, and a first-aid kit kept within reach
chunks.spokenText: Safety glasses, hearing protection for power tools, and a first-aid kit kept within reach.

chunks.text: Buy the best tool you can afford in each category, but buy one category at a time.
chunks.spokenText: Buy the best tool you can afford in each category, but buy one category at a time.

chunks.text: A good square that you trust will serve you longer than a set of cheap tools you have to second-guess.
chunks.spokenText: A good square that you trust will serve you longer than a set of cheap tools you have to second-guess.

chunks.text: Sweep the floor.
chunks.spokenText: Sweep the floor.

chunks.text: Put a jar of offcuts beside the bench for small pieces, and a bin for shavings.
chunks.spokenText: Put a jar of offcuts beside the bench for small pieces, and a bin for shavings.

chunks.text: Find out where the light switch is, and where your phone can be charged without leaving the bench.
chunks.spokenText: Find out where the light switch is, and where your phone can be charged without leaving the bench.

chunks.text: This is the least exciting part of woodworking, and it is the part most beginners skip.
chunks.spokenText: This is the least exciting part of woodworking, and it is the part most beginners skip.

chunks.text: But a bench that is set up well makes every later chapter feel calmer.
chunks.spokenText: But a bench that is set up well makes every later chapter feel calmer.

chunks.text: You will know where things are, you will trust your tools, and you will not need to stop halfway through a cut to look for a clamp.
